description: Copy ID check digit depended only on the last digit of the seat number so C101-0 passed as valid for C001-0
cause: First draft used (seat*7+3) mod 10; multiples of 10 vanish
fix: Weighted digit sum with weights 3,7,1 (coprime to 10)
lesson: Test every single-digit change exhaustively; a check that looks fine on a few examples can ignore whole positions
